name: Last Night at the Big Top
tagline: Sawdust, sideshow secrets, and a ringmaster who took his final bow.
description: The last week of the season. Striped tents, a lit-up Ferris wheel, candyfloss and calliope music, a sideshow tent full of wonders, and a ringmaster everybody has a reason to hate. A storm has closed the road, and the show must go on.
artStyle: Vintage 1950s circus poster, bold hand-lettered type, bulb lights, red and cream stripes, sawdust and lamplight

cocktails.name: The Ringmaster
cocktails.recipe: Bourbon, lemon, a spoon of cherry syrup, shaken and topped with soda.
cocktails.mocktail: Cherry syrup, lemon and soda water, with a maraschino cherry on top.

cocktails.name: Candy Apple Fizz
cocktails.recipe: Apple brandy, apple juice and a dash of caramel syrup, topped with ginger ale.
cocktails.mocktail: Apple juice, caramel syrup and ginger ale, with a caramel-dipped rim.
